proof_summary: A residue-class count modulo the primorial $30030$ (with $\varphi(30030)=5760$) yields the linear estimate $\pi(5M)\le M$ for $M\ge10^6$; induction therefore bounds every term by $B=10^6+\sum_i v_i$. Consequently only finitely many five-term windows can occur, so two windows repeat by pigeonhole, and the deterministic order-five recurrence propagates that equality forever, giving eventual periodicity.
